decisions.reason: The MMAK plant concept extends the firm's core shredding and screening know-how, has a quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros a year, and fits the firm's modular direction, so the firm can interpret its results and keep improving it.
The mobile slow-speed shredder sits at the heart of the firm's existing competence and has kept its own page for two years, though it may be folded into the 2024 shredder line.

As the flagship modular line backed by a documented customer case and quantified savings, it builds directly on the firm's environmental-technology knowledge and R&D, making it a core learning platform.
The new slow-speed shredder line is close to the firm's established offer, so the firm can absorb market feedback and refine it through its own R&D.
The spiral shaft screen line extends the firm's screening expertise into modular processing, which it can develop with its existing knowledge and research cooperation.
